description: This Java class 'UomWorker' provides utility methods for handling units of measure (UOM), including conversions between time units and general UOM conversions via a service call.

classes.name: UomWorker
classes.description: Final utility class for unit of measure operations, including time conversions and UOM conversions.

methods.name: uomTimeToCalTime
methods.description: Converts a UOM ID representing a time unit into a Calendar field and multiplier array.

methods.name: addUomTime
methods.description: Adds a specified amount of time to a Calendar object based on UOM ID and value.

methods.name: convertUom
methods.description: Converts a value from one UOM to another using a service call.
